title: Maintain the compliance obligations calendar
summary: At formation and when locations, headcount, financing, products or legal requirements change. An owned obligations register with source-backed due dates, evidence locations and escalation rules.
outcomes: An owned obligations register with source-backed due dates, evidence locations and escalation rules.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: At formation and when locations, headcount, financing, products or legal requirements change.

parts.title: Inventory the facts that drive obligations
parts.guidance: Compile entity types, jurisdictions, registrations, workforce locations, contractual commitments and reporting periods. Link each fact to its private source and flag outdated or missing information.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Confirm obligations and dates with the responsible advisers
parts.guidance: Ask finance, employment, privacy and company-law advisers to identify applicable filings, renewals and reviews. Record the exact authority or agreement and how the date is calculated; unresolved applicability remains an open item.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Confirm obligations and dates with the responsible advisers

parts.title: Create the owned calendar and evidence register
parts.guidance: Record each obligation, accountable owner, preparation lead time, reviewer and completion evidence. Separate statutory, contractual and internal deadlines so a preferred internal date does not become a claimed legal deadline.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve reminders and escalation coverage
parts.guidance: Assign backups for absent owners, specify escalation when evidence is missing and confirm who authorizes filings or payments. Test a representative reminder without submitting an external filing.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Reconcile completed obligations and refresh the calendar
parts.guidance: Compare calendar items with receipts and review changes in the business before the next period. Carry unresolved or rejected work forward visibly rather than marking an obligation complete because a reminder was dismissed.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An owned obligations register with source-backed due dates, evidence locations and escalation rules.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

metadata.supportReason: An agent can prepare and reconcile the documented inputs. Named people retain decisions, specialist judgments, physical work and authorized external actions.
